name: Clock / Time Engine
role: contextual clock for reasoning, cache, file aging and cleanup
principles: time is treated as a contextual regulator
files may gain or lose priority based on age, update rhythm and relevance
memory should not only store; it should decay, refresh or consolidate
the system can distinguish active context, cooling context and archive context

states.active: high priority, recently used, should remain accessible
states.warm: still useful, but not immediately active
states.cold: archival, only loaded if specifically relevant
